hypothesis: While squadmates are alive and able to exchange traffic, Stencil v50 bounds epoch drift and converges without conflicting commitments on the giant 4FFA8 case that most stressed v49 and v50.
what_changes: No player change. Run three fresh full-seat episodes on the same giant campaign map and pinned four-entrant roster, with Stencil v50 and Daveey v25 in every episode. Correct the prior terminal metric by evaluating only concurrently alive squadmates.

instrument.summary: Three full-seat 32-agent giant-4FFA8 hosted episodes with streamed artifacts.
instrument.detail: Paintbot 0.7.199 4ffa8, campaign cell 4 mapSeed 327479547 mapSize giant; entrant blocks paintbot-focusfire:v25, alphashot:v368, co-gas-ctf-simple-relhalpha:v38, stencil:v50 repeated modulo four. Inspect every available Stencil snapshot and order transition.

if_true: No same-squad/epoch directive conflict; at least 90% of available Stencil artifacts commit and follow orders; commits exceed timeouts; and no epoch gap greater than one among concurrently alive squadmates persists for 90 consecutive ticks (two 45-tick rebroadcast intervals).
if_false: Any directive conflict recurs, fewer than 75% of available seats commit or follow, timeouts equal/exceed commits, or a live epoch gap greater than one persists for at least 90 consecutive ticks.
decision_rule: Confirm only if every true-side threshold passes. Refute if any false-side condition occurs. Otherwise call the result inconclusive, including if artifact availability is too low to inspect at least 22 of 24 Stencil seats.
confounds: Permanent elimination freezes a dead process's epoch: exclude ticks where a member is not alive rather than treating death as protocol drift.
Transient propagation is expected in an asynchronous shout protocol: the bound is two configured 45-tick rebroadcast intervals, not instantaneous equality.
Artifact omission can hide a seat: require at least 22 of 24 Stencil artifacts and report omissions.
Three games test the stressed protocol mechanism, not win-rate superiority.

verdict.evidence: Twenty-three of 24 Stencil artifacts were available; all 23 committed and followed orders, with 154 commits, 17 timeouts, and 25 resyncs. However, four same-squad/epoch directive conflicts appeared across all three episodes, and one live epoch gap persisted for 122 ticks. Trace-level root cause: updateConsensus stored a locked vote but continued to count and publish a newly recomputed choice after late proposals. v51 corrects that exact path.
